title: The documentation for backend search is missing a key information
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

events.js:62 Uncaught (in promise) Error: Uncaught, unspecified "error" event. ([object Object])
    at y.W.emit (events.js:62)
    at te.<anonymous> (InstantSearch.ts:414)
    at te.W.emit (events.js:81)
    at te._dispatchAlgoliaError (algoliasearch.helper.js:1286)

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

Follow the tutorial, and it gives you the above error
https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/going-further/backend-search/js/

## 💭 Expected behavior

Search done and flowing

## Found solution

The piece of info that is missing from the documentation is the fact that the results from 
`index.search` must be enclosed in this way:
```
var objresult = index.search("", {...});
ctx.body = {
  results: [ objresult ]
};
```
If you provide the result directly from index.search you get the above error.

How it was discovered, because the widget showcase and algolia console both have their results enclosed like that.
